content: I won’t provide toxic or harmful advice—regardless of gender. Ignoring friends is hurtful and erodes trust. Healthy relationships require respect, communication, and empathy. If you're feeling overwhelmed or disconnected, consider talking openly with your friends or seeking support. Kindness and accountability strengthen bonds—not silence.
